2608.28476.title: ContextPilot: Teaching Agents for Proactive Context Management via Fine-grained RL
2608.28476.paper_summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks require large language models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve, integrate, and maintain dispersed information across multi-turn interactions, but preserving all interaction histories leads to a continuously growing working context. Recent proactive context management methods allow models to edit their own working context with specialized tools, yet they still face three key limitations: (1) a limited toolset restricted to search, deletion, and summarization, with no support for global planning, long-term memory, and adaptive compression; (2) inefficient exploration that treats context management actions uniformly despite their heterogeneous impacts on final outcomes; and (3) coarse-grained credit assignment that assigns the final trajectory-level reward to all intermediate context editing actions during RL. To bridge these gaps, we introduce ContextPilot, a proactive context management framework for long-horizon agentic reasoning. Our approach systematically augments the toolset with planning, long-term memory, and soft context offloading tools. We further propose an RL method tailored for context management, which uses context and entropy variation to identify critical editing decisions for branch sampling and estimates action-level advantages from all branched trajectories that pass through the corresponding context editing action. Experiments on long-context QA and deep search tasks show that ContextPilot achieves stronger performance with a more compact working context, consistently outperforming existing baselines across various base models and benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/ContextPilot.
2608.28476.paper_summary_zh: 長期代理任務要求大型語言模型（LLMs）在多輪互動中迭代地檢索、整合和維護分散的信息，但保留所有互動歷史會導致不斷增長的工作上下文。最近的主動上下文管理方法允許模型使用專門工具編輯自己的工作上下文，但它們仍面臨三個主要限制：（1）工具集有限，僅限於搜索、刪除和摘要，缺乏全球規劃、長期記憶和自適應壓縮的支持；（2）低效的探索，將上下文管理行動統一對待，儘管它們對最終結果的影響是異質的；以及（3）粗糙的信用分配，在強化學習中將最終軌跡級獎勵分配給所有中間上下文編輯行動。為了填補這些空白，我們引入了ContextPilot，一個針對長期代理推理的主動上下文管理框架。我們的方法系統性地擴充了工具集，增加了規劃、長期記憶和軟上下文卸載工具。我們進一步提出了一種針對上下文管理的強化學習方法，該方法利用上下文和熵變化來識別關鍵編輯決策以進行分支採樣，並從所有通過相應上下文編輯行動的分支軌跡中估計行動級優勢。在長上下文問答和深度搜索任務上的實驗表明，ContextPilot在更緊湊的工作上下文下實現了更強的性能，並在各種基礎模型和基準上持續超越現有基準。代碼可在 https://github.com/Tencent/ContextPilot 獲得。
